Section A (Sources of Funds) is identical to the one printed in 2025-q3-ldrrmf (Total Funds Available 412,571,024.80); it was not updated for Q4.

This is Part I of a two-part report: it has no utilization total, subtotals or balance. Section B continues directly in 2025-q4-ldrrmf-part-2 (Part II page 1 resumes with further "payment of 100% just compensation ... skywalk near cebu light industrial park (clip) in basak" items), so totalUtilized and balance are null here.
All utilization amounts are printed in the Mitigation Fund 70% column; the QRF, NDRRM, Other LGUs, Other Sources and Total columns are blank on every utilization row.
Under "CONTINUING AND CURRENT APPROPRIATION" the JANUARY heading row itself prints 1,570,243.81 (no particulars); it is recorded as an item row labelled "JANUARY".

Pages 7, 9 and 10 carry no month heading; their rows are assigned the month of the last heading before them in PDF page order (JANUARY for page 7, SEPTEMBER for pages 9-10, both under Continuing and Current Appropriation). The page order is as published and month assignment for those pages is therefore inferred, not printed.
Particulars are transcribed as printed, including typos ("Acrylic plague", "evacutaion", "cityincluding", "ayment").
